scope_lock.source: During `npx @haposoft/cafekit`, add an opt-in prompt (and `--with-rtk` flag) that offers to install the rtk token-saver binary and register its official Claude Code PreToolUse hook via `rtk init -g`. Must be non-fatal, default OFF, manifest-tracked, and reuse the existing skills-setup opt-in pattern. Do NOT reimplement rtk's compression logic.
in_scope: New opt-in prompt asking whether to install the rtk token-saver
New `--with-rtk` CLI flag and CI/non-interactive default OFF
New install phase `setup-rtk` that detects/installs the rtk binary and runs `rtk init -g`
Non-fatal failure handling (never breaks the cafekit install)
i18n keys (en/ja/vi) for the prompt and status messages
Dependency precheck (jq) with graceful skip when missing
out_of_scope: Reimplementing rtk filters / compression logic in cafekit
Writing a custom PreToolUse hook (rtk's `rtk init -g` owns the hook)
Auto-enabling rtk by default without explicit consent
Building rtk from source / managing Rust toolchain beyond best-effort install
Uninstall/cleanup of the rtk binary itself (cafekit only tracks what it added)
Any change to the hapo-ai-hub gateway repo

tasks/task-R3-01-i18n-and-help.md.title: Localize prompt/messages, help text, and summary line

design_context.discovery_reason: Extends the existing cafekit installer pipeline (packages/spec/bin) which already has an opt-in skills-deps phase to mirror.
